validation.candidate: Memory pass, normal/checked/TSan concurrency, VM protection/zero-fill, immutable code revisions, mission literals and renderer handoff plus required renderer prerequisites passed. Full checked engine built and ran the offline match.
validation.retained: Restored pthread guard passes the expanded memory-pass test:23 denied-access faults, nested pending writer,8000 emitted access cycles and16000 permission publications from four writers; normal and ThreadSanitizer.

next_action: Use optimized machine-code generation on identical checked bitcode, preserving barriers and external-call gates, then verify and compare the full offline app. A standalone llc-O2 experiment reduced one checked SSE helper text from7368 to4748 bytes; no game performance claim follows.
